assertion_tested: On the declared finite integer table-relation and F2/F13 controls, optional propagation, learning, normalization and set operations preserve the exact feasible assignments/plaintexts and deterministic top-k.
coefficient_domain: Exact integers, F2, F13 and CRT modulo 26

domains.table_variables: 0..12 variables with domains of at most 26 explicit integer values

acceptance: Exact oracle agreement is required. A local measured reduction can justify an optional technique, never a universal improvement or a Kryptos decipherment. Proposal statuses are tracked individually; missing implementation or evidence stays incomplete.
non_claims: No unknown Kryptos model is inferred
No timing-only gain is called fewer search steps
Generic finite-relation APIs do not by themselves establish integration into the existing main cipher optimizer
No excluded configuration is called infeasible merely because of a resource cap
